description: First major V5 errors in the completed V5-versus-V4 validation run. These positions are diagnostic regressions only; they are no longer held-out evidence.

positions.label: Validation game 4, Black move 17
positions.diagnosis: V5 pushed e5 and changed a roughly defensible position into a clearly inferior one; Kg8 preserves king safety and coordination.

positions.label: Validation game 10, Black move 32
positions.diagnosis: V5 moved the king away instead of playing h6, allowing White's connected advanced pawns to become decisive.

positions.label: Validation game 15, White move 27
positions.diagnosis: V5 answered ...c4 with Rb7+ and discarded a winning advantage; Ra5 keeps the rook behind the passer and controls Black's connected pawns.

positions.label: Validation game 17, White move 16
positions.diagnosis: V5 placed the wrong rook on b1 and allowed Black to consolidate the advanced b-pawn; Rac1 contests the open file while preserving flexibility.

positions.label: Validation game 19, Black move 17
positions.diagnosis: V5 played the natural-looking Rfc8 and lost its advantage; dxc4 resolves the central tension before committing the rook.
